properties.title: Flood Advisory issued November 21 at 4:48PM AST until November 21 at 6:45PM AST by NWS San Juan PR
properties.description:
* WHAT...Urban area and small stream flooding caused by excessive
rainfall is expected.

* WHERE...Naguabo, Rio Grande...

* WHEN...Until 645 PM AST.

* IMPACTS...Rises in small streams and normally dry arroyos. Some
low-water crossings may become impassable.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 448 PM AST, Doppler radar indicated heavy rain due to
thunderstorms. This  will cause urban and small stream flooding.
Between 1 and 2 inches of rain have fallen.

properties.title: Special Marine Warning issued November 21 at 3:46PM EST until November 21 at 4:45PM EST by NWS Melbourne FL
properties.description:
SMWMLB

The National Weather Service in Melbourne has issued a

* Special Marine Warning for...
Sebastian Inlet to Jupiter Inlet 20-60 nm...

* Until 445 PM EST.

* At 346 PM EST, severe thunderstorms capable of producing
waterspouts were located along a line from 43 NM northeast of Hobe
Sound Beach to 41 NM east of Jupiter Island, or along a line from
43 NM east of Saint Lucie Nuclear Power Plant to 41 NM east of
Jupiter Island, moving north at 30 knots.

HAZARD...Waterspouts, wind gusts 34 knots or greater, and small
hail.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Waterspouts can easily overturn boats and create locally
hazardous seas. Small craft could be damaged in briefly
higher winds and suddenly higher waves.

* Locations impacted include...
Mainly open waters of Sebastian Inlet to Jupiter Inlet 20-60 nm.
properties.instruction:
Boaters should seek safe harbor immediately until these storms pass.
Wind gusts 34 knots or greater, high waves, dangerous lightning, and
heavy rain are possible with these storms.

Thunderstorms can produce sudden waterspouts. Waterspouts can easily
overturn boats and create locally hazardous seas. Seek safe harbor
immediately.
properties.area: Sebastian Inlet to Jupiter Inlet 20-60 nm

properties.title: Special Weather Statement issued November 21 at 3:29PM EST by NWS Tampa Bay Ruskin FL
properties.description:
At 328 PM EST, Doppler radar was tracking a strong thunderstorm
capable of producing a funnel clouds 13 miles southeast of Wauchula,
moving northeast at 25 mph.

HAZARD...Funnel clouds and wind gusts up to 40 mph.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Minor damage to outdoor objects is possible. Gusty winds
could knock down tree limbs and blow around unsecured
objects.

Locations impacted include...
Sebring, Avon Park, Sebring Regional Airport, Sweetwater, Frostproof,
Zolfo Springs, Lake Josephine, Avon Park Executive Airport,
Crewsville, and Sebring Shores.
properties.instruction: If outdoors, consider seeking shelter inside a building.

properties.title: Special Marine Warning issued November 21 at 3:26PM EST until November 21 at 4:30PM EST by NWS Miami FL
properties.description:
SMWMFL

The National Weather Service in Miami has issued a

* Special Marine Warning for...
Waters from Deerfield Beach to Ocean Reef FL from 20 to 60 NM
excluding the territorial waters of Bahamas...

* Until 430 PM EST.

* At 325 PM EST, a severe thunderstorm capable of producing
waterspouts was located 28 nm east of Surfside, moving east at 20
knots.

HAZARD...Waterspouts, wind gusts to 40 knots, and small hail.

SOURCE...Radar.

IMPACT...Waterspouts can easily overturn boats and create locally
hazardous seas. Small craft could be damaged in briefly
higher winds and suddenly higher waves.

* The severe thunderstorm will remain over mainly open waters.
properties.instruction:

Report severe weather to the Coast Guard or the National Weather
Service. You can also share your report with NWS Miami on Facebook
and Twitter.

properties.title: Flood Warning issued November 21 at 2:02PM EST by NWS Melbourne FL
properties.description:
...The Flood Warning continues for the following rivers in Florida...

St Johns River Near Astor affecting Volusia and Lake Counties.

.Heavy rainfall working its way through the basin, in combination
with strong north-northeast flow, has caused river levels on The St
Johns River at Astor to rise into Major Flood Stage. Continued rises
through Major Flood Stage are forecast through the middle of next
week.

For the St. Johns River...including Astor...Major flooding is
forecast.

* WHAT...Major flooding is occurring and major flooding is forecast.

* WHERE...St Johns River near Astor.

* WHEN...Until further notice.

* IMPACTS...At 4.0 feet, Major flooding occurs with water entering
many structures on canals and along the river. Long duration
flooding will occur, with levels taking weeks to months to return
below flood stage. Water rescues will be necessary. River Road
becomes inaccessible, with 1 to 2 feet water depth in numerous
homes on Wildhog, Possum, and Bonnet roads. Roads along Blue Creek
are inaccessible with major flooding of homes on Otter, Branch and
Chestnut roads. Camp South Moon Road and Juno Trail are
inaccessible.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 1:30 PM EST Saturday the stage was 4.0 feet.
- Bankfull stage is 2.0 feet.
- Recent Activity...The maximum river stage in the 24 hours ending
at 1:30 PM EST Saturday was 4.0 feet.
- Forecast...The river is expected to remain steady above flood
stage at 4.1 feet.
- Flood stage is 2.3 feet.
- http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood
properties.instruction:
Turn around, don't drown when encountering flooded roads. Most flood
deaths occur in vehicles.

Motorists should not attempt to drive around barricades or drive cars
through flooded areas.

Caution is urged when walking near riverbanks.

Additional information is available at www.weather.gov.

The next statement will be issued this evening at 1100 PM EST.

properties.description:
...The Flood Warning continues for the following rivers in Florida...

St Johns River Near Above Lake Harney affecting Seminole County.

.Heavy rainfall has caused river levels on the St. Johns Above Lake
Harney near Geneva to rise into Major Flood Stage. Continued rises
through Major Flood Stage are forecast through early next week. River
levels may begin to slowly decline mid to late next week while
remaining in Major Flood Stage.

* WHERE...St Johns River near Above Lake Harney.

* WHEN...Until further notice.

* IMPACTS...At 10.8 feet, Water covers State Road 46 and it may
become impassable near Jungle Road and Prevatt Road. Standing water

in some areas. Flooding becomes more significant to structures and
marinas from above Lake Harney to the Lake Jesup area.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 12:30 PM EST Saturday the stage was 12.3 feet.
- Bankfull stage is 6.0 feet.
- Recent Activity...The maximum river stage in the 24 hours ending
at 12:30 PM EST Saturday was 12.3 feet.
- Forecast...The river is expected to rise to a crest of 13.0 feet
early tomorrow afternoon.

properties.description:

St Johns River Near Cocoa 9w affecting Brevard County.

.Extreme rainfall over the headwaters of the St. Johns River has
caused the river near Cocoa to reach Major Flood Stage, well above
its previous record flood stage. The river level will remain steady
into the middle of next week.

forecast.

* WHAT...Major flooding is occurring and major flooding is forecast.

in the Lake Poinsett area west of Cocoa, also low lying homes in

Fish Camp.
